label: backlog
definition: The ordered list of work the project may do next, kept on GitHub: every open issue whose board Status is Backlog. A standalone open issue that is neither an effort nor a sub-issue belongs here until a sprint takes it. The owner orders it; cckit status --board reads it.
is_not: The sprint backlog: the backlog is everything not yet taken; the sprint backlog is what one sprint took from it.
The board: the board shows every status; the backlog is the Backlog column of it.
A plan: a plan is the ordered waves of work already chosen; the backlog is what waits to be chosen.
